card.name: Open parenthesis before an acronym
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis right after a spelled-out multi-word term, where the capitalized abbreviation comes next, such as (CHC) or (ITI).

modes.label: Medical term then acronym
modes.description: A full clinical term is followed by its abbreviation in brackets.
modes.example: Capillary leak syndrome<< (>>CLS), including life-threatening or fatal reactions

modes.label: Non-medical term then acronym
modes.description: A policy, company or technical term is followed by its abbreviation in brackets.
modes.example: Meghan now works for Canadian Cartographic Corporation<< (>>CCC) : http://www.goge

card.writes: It promotes repeated capital-letter strings such as CCC, PPP and FFF, which fits predicting an all-caps abbreviation.
card.plain: It fires at the bracket that opens an abbreviation right after the full name is written out.
